brief: Draft the scene and its sequel from the scene record. The scene runs goal, conflict, and disaster: Tomas tries the key and it snaps. The sequel runs reaction, dilemma, and decision: state the dilemma as the choice it is, and end on the decision without carrying it out. The chest stays shut and the question of who left the key stays open. First person, past tense, under 320 words. Invent nothing.
name: scene-sequel
